name: supacrawl
description: Sitemap-based website monitoring tool with DDoS-safe crawling

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @supacrawl/core build && concurrently --raw -n core,server,dashboard -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm --filter @supacrawl/core dev" "pnpm --filter @supacrawl/server dev" "pnpm --filter @supacrawl/dashboard dev"
scripts.dev:server: pnpm --filter @supacrawl/core build && concurrently --raw -n core,server -c yellow,blue "pnpm --filter @supacrawl/core dev" "pnpm --filter @supacrawl/server dev"
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules .turbo ; pnpm install
